design.question: Can a released RWKV-7 0.1B model learn held-out three-stage semantic supersession under a known-working recurrent update scope?
design.curriculum: same 16-example three-stage supersession curriculum used for Mamba diagnostics

claim_boundary: RWKV-7 0.1B, one recurrent parameter family, 80 optimizer steps, synthetic supersession curriculum. This is a candidate-backbone teachability diagnostic, not a final architecture verdict.
